claim_text: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows by defining multi-agent orchestration contracts and deterministic route-policy dispatch.

Expanded enterprise workflow adoption through CFO-aligned adoption motions that connected reusable AI platform commercialization with usage-based forecasting and partner-supported customer value realization.
Strengthened production agentic AI reliability with audit-grade observability for regulated AI workflows, supported by evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls.
Compressed the AI systems lifecycle from six months to three weeks by standardizing intake, production readiness, monitoring, remediation, and exit disposition governance.
Built high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across cloud data infrastructure, vector services, and parallel decision workflows.
Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a repeatable operating model.
